description: Non-material amendment to planning permission Ref. PP/22/01420 dated 09th September 2022 [Variation of condition 2 (compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission ref. PP/14/07745 to allow retention of east flank wall utilising blind windows; to allow use of mechanical ventilation louvres to front entrance roof and east elevation; to allow a revised mews facade, addition of basement level 1 mezzanine and second floor mezzanine with revised roof plan, and revised internal layout including feature stair] to allow internal layout alterations: simplification of the design, including removal of mezzanine floors (reducing the proposed GIA by 59 sqm - back to the size of the original July 2014 permission) and introduction of a more traditional main staircase arrangement; revised ground floor level for the central section; and rearrangement of internal partitions
